divergences: Desktop wallpaper is a CSS gradient approximation of the photographic capture; exact hue/luminance per-pixel values diverge, especially in the saturated purple/magenta corners.

Window vibrancy (backdrop-filter blur) samples the CSS-gradient backdrop instead of the true photo, so the window's left edge (closest to the brightest wallpaper region) shows a larger per-pixel color delta than the plain right side of the window.

List-row icons are inline-SVG Lucide-style approximations; glyph stroke placement/antialiasing differs slightly from the reference's rendered icon font, producing small local diffs inside icon tiles (e.g. the yellow inbox icon on the selected 'dash' row).

demo.notes: Browses the Brain Inbox recents (dash → sideshow → lively-rafter-gf4n) via arrow keys before any typing, then reveals the query span (data-demo-key=query, canonical-hidden behind the long placeholder) and typeInto's 'dash' over it, filtering all 8 result rows (3 recents + 5 Suggested) via data-demo-match tokens drawn from each row's name. Only the 'dash' row's token starts with the 'dash' prefix chain, so the applyState checkpoint 'dash-filtered' moveSelection's back onto it and hides the now-empty Suggested section header. Two closing keypress+activate steps flash 'Ask Your Brain' (↵) and 'Agent' (⌘↵) before looping. Exploration controls cover the input (typing/backspace re-filters) and list (arrow keys / hover / click re-select among visible rows).
